title: lantana strigosa
intro: Lantana strigosa, commonly known as Yellow Button Bush, is a species of flowering plant in the verbena family. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties and is known to possess several health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of fever. The therapeutic actions of Lantana strigosa include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral properties, which can help to treat various infections and diseases. The bioactive constituents of Lantana strigosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
